scripts.preinstall: node -e "const v=process.versions.node; const major=Number(v.split('.')[0]); if(major!==22){console.error('Node ' + v + ' is not allowed. Use Node 22.x only.'); process.exit(1);}"
scripts.dev: concurrently -c blue,magenta -n backend,web "env -u NO_COLOR -u TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN -u TEST_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN -u TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME -u TEST_TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME -u CONTENT_BOT_TOKEN -u TEST_BOT_TOKEN pnpm -s --dir backend dev" "/bin/sh -c 'until curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:3001/health >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done; env -u NO_COLOR pnpm -s --dir apps/web dev'"
scripts.dev:bot: COMMIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD) SCHEDULER_ENABLED=false NOTIFICATION_WORKER_ENABLED=false RUNTIME_OUTBOX_WORKER_ENABLED=false pnpm dev:tunnel
scripts.verify:local: pnpm -C backend exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm -C apps/web exec tsc --noEmit && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3001/health >/dev/null && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/telegram/webhook/health >/dev/null
scripts.prisma:migrate: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process'); const args=process.argv.slice(1); if(args[0]==='deploy'){console.error('Use pnpm prisma:migrate:deploy instead of pnpm prisma:migrate deploy.'); process.exit(1)} const cmd=['--filter','@starway/db','run','prisma:migrate']; if(args.length){cmd.push('--', ...args)} const result=spawnSync('pnpm', cmd, {stdio:'inherit', shell: process.platform==='win32'}); process.exit(result.status ?? 1)"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir packages/shared build && pnpm --dir packages/db build && pnpm --filter @starway/ai run build && pnpm --dir backend build && pnpm --dir apps/web build
scripts.clean: pnpm --dir packages/shared clean && pnpm --dir packages/db clean && pnpm --dir packages/ai clean && pnpm --dir backend clean && pnpm --dir apps/web clean
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir packages/shared typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/db typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/ai typecheck && pnpm --dir backend typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck
scripts.test:all: pnpm test:funnel && pnpm test:golden && pnpm test:integration
scripts.test:assistant:e2e: pnpm exec vitest run backend/src/modules/assistant/assistant.e2e.test.ts backend/src/modules/assistant/assistant.scheduler.test.ts backend/src/modules/assistant/decisionEngine.test.ts backend/src/modules/assistant/service.test.ts backend/src/modules/ai/agentGateway.test.ts backend/src/modules/telegram-mentor/handlers/intelligence.runtime.test.ts backend/src/modules/telegram-mentor/conversation/engine/conversationEngine.test.ts backend/src/modules/telegram-mentor/router/messageRouter.test.ts && pnpm test:mentor:quality && pnpm --dir backend exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --dir apps/web exec tsc --noEmit
